description: Assemble what is needed to analyse a record: its container images, CMSSW release and global tag; the condition-data, VM and validated-run records for its run periods; example software that declares it works with the record; and quoted sections of the guides the record links (the first two are fetched). Container images, software and guide code are licensed separately from the CC0 data. Use cern_opendata_list_files for the record's files.

recid.description: Record id: up to 12 digits (6004), optionally after an experiment prefix (cms-93956); recid:6004 or a portal record URL also work. cern_opendata_search_records and cern_opendata_get_records return it.

name: cern_opendata_get_analysis_env

environment_records.description: Condition, VM and validation records for the run periods, and others linking here.

items.description: One Environment record for this record (condition data, VM, validation).

kind.description: From the secondary type: condition data, virtual machine, validated-run list, or other.

portal_url.description: The record page on the portal.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `record_not_found`: No record has this recid. `rate_limited`: The portal's 60-a-minute budget is spent: it answered 429, or the request could not start within the call's deadline. data.retryAfter is set. `upstream_unreadable`: The portal answered with a body the server could not read: not JSON, missing the expected envelope, or over the byte ceiling (then data.retryable is false). Also raised when a search answers 404. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

example_software.description: Software records that declare they work with this record.

items.description: One Software record that declares it works with this record.

license_id.description: License the software record states (such as GPL-3.0-only); absent when none.

portal_url.description: The record page on the portal.

secondary.description: Secondary types, such as Analysis or Validation; empty when none.

source_code_repository_url.description: Source code repository URL, when stated.

guides.description: Every portal guide linked in the usage section.

items.description: One portal guide the record links in its usage section.

anchor.description: Section anchor the link points at, when it has one.

fetched.description: False when the guide was not fetched (only the first two are) or was not found; notice says which.

link_description.description: The link text the record gives the guide.

section.description: The linked section (or the opening section) as markdown, as the portal sent it but with LF line ends; at most 12,000 characters.

section_truncated.description: True when the section was cut at 12,000 characters; the notice names the body_offset where the quote stops.

slug.description: Doc slug; pass it as the one id of cern_opendata_get_records for the page body, with body_offset to read on past a cut (the notice names the offset).

notice.description: What could not be assembled and how to get it: an empty environment, linked records that could not be read, guides not fetched, not found or cut, a guide anchor no heading carries, or more linked records than shown.

other_links.description: The other usage links (getting-started pages and the like).

run_period.description: Run periods the record covers, such as Run2012B.

separately_licensed.description: Always true: images, software and guide code are licensed apart from the CC0 data.

container_images.description: Container images for the environment; empty when the record lists none.

description.description: Environment description as the portal sent it (HTML).

environment_recid.description: Recid of the environment (VM or container) record, when stated.

type.description: Record type as the portal classifies it.

primary.description: Primary type: Dataset, Software, Environment, Documentation, Supplementaries or News. Empty when the record states none.

secondary.description: Secondary types, such as Collision or Simulated; empty when none.

title: Get CERN Open Data Analysis Environment
